sections.markdown:
## C2 — License-loss and point-system confusables with knowledge-graph hints

FACT_ID: sec03-R01 | anchor: A19
After revocation you must apply for a new license and pass the complete examinations, whereas after cancellation the issue is that you were never entitled to the license at all. [A19]
Why it matters: group_hint license-loss-types; prereq_hint sec03-F01; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec03-F05, sec03-F06.
Source: [A19 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec03-R02 | anchor: A20
A suspended license is reinstated when the period ends, unless it expired during the suspension or the suspension requirements were not all met. [A20]
Why it matters: group_hint license-loss-types; prereq_hint sec03-F11; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec03-F11, sec03-R01.
Source: [A20 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec03-R03 | anchor: A19
Mandatory revocation for driving under the influence of alcohol is triggered by a second or subsequent conviction, and the same holds for controlled-substance impairment. [A19]
Why it matters: group_hint impaired-driving-penalties; prereq_hint sec03-F08; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec03-F08, sec03-F18.
Source: [A19 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec03-R04 | anchor: A21
Reckless driving and an Admin Per Se violation each carry 6 points, one more than failing to yield or passing a stopped school bus. [A21]
Why it matters: group_hint point-values; prereq_hint sec03-F19; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec03-F21, sec03-F22, sec03-F10.
Source: [A21 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec03-R05 | anchor: A21
Speeding up to 25 mph over the limit costs 2 points, but 26 mph or more over costs 5 points, the same as failing to yield. [A21]
Why it matters: group_hint point-values; prereq_hint sec03-F19; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec03-F24, sec03-F22.
Source: [A21 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec03-R06 | anchor: A21
Following too closely and ignoring work-zone markers each carry 3 points, one less than illegal passing at 4 points. [A21]
Why it matters: group_hint point-values; prereq_hint sec03-F19; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec03-F23, sec03-F25.
Source: [A21 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec03-R07 | anchor: A21
Passing a stopped school bus carries 5 points, while an emergency vehicle violation carries 2 points. [A21]
Why it matters: group_hint point-values; prereq_hint sec03-F19; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec03-F22, sec03-F26.
Source: [A21 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec03-R08 | anchor: A21
The shortest point suspension, 60 days, starts at 12 points within 2 years, and the longest, 365 days, starts at 24 points. [A21]
Why it matters: group_hint point-schedule; prereq_hint sec03-F28; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec03-F28, sec03-F29.
Source: [A21 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec03-R09 | anchor: A19
Every reinstatement costs at least $100, with $50 more for a late license surrender, $25 more after a drug conviction, and $50 more after a child-support suspension. [A19]
Why it matters: group_hint reinstatement; prereq_hint sec03-F02; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec03-F02, sec03-F03, sec03-F04.
Source: [A19 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec03-R10 | anchor: A20
The suspension list names 4 or more points on the record or 2 or more moving violations on a graduated license as two separate grounds for suspension. [A20]
Why it matters: group_hint suspension-grounds; prereq_hint sec03-F17; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec03-F17, sec03-R08.
Source: [A20 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0020]
